name: Arshad Pappu
real_life_parallel: Real Arshad Pappu — rival Lyari gang leader; beheaded 2013

biography.background: Rival Lyari gang leader opposing Rehman Dakait's PAC dominance. Traditional gang leader without PAC's political sophistication. Hedging relationship with Jamali (who played both sides) provided temporary protection.
biography.criminal_model: Traditional gang rivalry vs PAC's political-criminal hybrid
biography.film_1_role: Rival to Rehman; Jamali hedging object
biography.film_2_role: Referenced as killed; beheading demonstrates PAC brutality

risk_profile.description: High risk; violent death expected in Lyari power struggles
